THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Peanut Butter Cup Blondie Cookie Creami

PBfit protein Creami with two Reese’s Thins mixed in, finished with peanut-butter and chocolate drizzles. Approximately 380 calories and 41g protein for the whole finished pint with Nurri 2%.

YIELD1 serving
TOTAL TIME5 min rest + 24 hr freeze
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~380 cal | ~41g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: Amounts and nutrition refer to one complete finished pint.

Ingredients

Ingredients

  • 1 cup ultra-filtered 2% milk (Nurri for this estimate)
  • 1/2 serving Opportuniteas unflavored whey isolate (label: 60 calories / 14g protein)
  • 2 tbsp monk-fruit/erythritol sweetener
  • 1/8 tsp guar gum
  • Pinch of salt

Ingredients — continued

  • 1 tbsp PBfit peanut butter powder
  • 2 Reese’s milk-chocolate Thins, for the mix-in
  • 1/2 tbsp PBfit, mixed with water a little at a time for drizzle
  • 1/2 tbsp Hershey’s sugar-free chocolate syrup

Allergens: milk, peanut, soy.

You want a peanut butter cup blondie Cookie Creami with PBfit, Reese’s Thins, and two drizzles.

Method

  1. 1.BLEND. Blend milk, whey, sweetener, guar gum, salt and 1 tbsp PBfit until smooth.
  2. 2.FREEZE. Freeze the pint upright and level for 24 hours. Rest on the counter for 5 minutes.
  3. 3.SPIN. Process on Regular Ice Cream.
  4. 4.MIX IN. Add two Reese’s milk-chocolate Thins after the first spin, then Respin without added liquid. Repeat if needed for your texture.
  5. 5.PB DRIZZLE. Mix 1/2 tbsp PBfit with water a little at a time until pourable.
  6. 6.FINISH. Scoop and finish with the PBfit drizzle and 1/2 tbsp Hershey’s sugar-free chocolate syrup.

Keys to success

  • Freeze upright and level for 24 hours, within the machine’s fill line.
  • Follow your Creami model’s safety and processing instructions.

Storage and reheating

Store: Freeze the unspun base upright and level. Spin and finish when ready to eat.

Reheat: Do not heat the pint.

Lasts: Follow the Creami machine guidance for storage and reprocessing.

Estimated nutrition

~380 cal | ~41g protein per 1 whole finished Creami pint.

Approximately 380 calories and 41g protein for the whole finished pint with Nurri 2%, including mix-ins and toppings. With Fairlife 2%: about 350 calories and 34g protein.
